slice_contract.real_problem: M11 stopped after four measurement-valid arms and one durably observed but accounting-incomplete arm; the result must be derived from canonical Store snapshots without treating acquisition interruption, a single task loss, or raw tool counts as a production candidate.
acceptance: validate the M11 input as one 0600 regular non-symlink hash-chained journal with exact file identity and no partial tail
derive all five canonical Store trajectories independently of the four frozen arm labels
separate product task loss from accounting acquisition interruption and from the expected security rejection
require the same stable loss code in at least two independent task IDs before returning a candidate audit
expose only canonical counts, stable loss codes and task IDs; never expose prompt, reasoning, tool arguments/content, evaluation IDs or credential material
produce byte-identical canonical JSON across repeated runs with no credential read or network access
slice_contract.owner: the existing trajectory-report mode in scripts/eval-m9b-fixed-pro-regression.py
slice_contract.old_path_replaced: manual inspection of the M11 journal and single-task failure extrapolation
slice_contract.cutover: retain the M11 manifest and read-only report path; no production path exists to delete

derivation.canonical_source: canonical_store_snapshot payload facts and canonical Runtime events
derivation.label_source: arm_result only, preserved separately from canonical evidence
derivation.measurement_interruption: a canonical Store snapshot without arm_result because acquisition stopped on accounting_incomplete
product_loss: verifier-passing workspace that never reaches a terminal Host receipt
non_loss: measurement interruption without a completed arm label
derivation.candidate_threshold: one identical stable loss_code across at least two distinct task IDs

exclude: raw tool count without causal loss
